verdict.rationale: Evidence contains only generic feature/pricing claims (e.g., 'handles tickets', 'takes action to update external systems', pay-per-resolution pricing model) but no concrete resolution-rate data, case studies, or independent benchmarks showing what share of conversations Fin fully resolves end-to-end versus deflects or escalates. Community commentary raises skepticism about whether an autonomous agent model is even the right approach for deterministic support tasks, but this doesn't confirm or deny a resolution metric either way — evidence simply doesn't establish the capability.
